cases: locks_type: typelock+namelock+int4 constant dedup copies Datatype pointer, typelock|namelock bits, offset/size; source unchanged with its single descendant
no_locks: unlocked constant copy keeps the ctor unknown base type pointer and gains no lock bits
mapentry_symbol: name-locked SymbolEntry on the constant is pointer-copied to the copy; mapped flag NOT copied (only typelock|namelock bits are)
mapentry_copy: copied entry keeps symbol name and entry identity (entry_same=1)
identity_return: same varnode re-set in the same slot returns at cc:107 without doubling descend
spacebase_exempt: spacebase-flagged constant skips dedup; both ops share the original varnode with two descendants
